units.source_text: 岛村一想起那句虽然引起了驹子的误会、然而却深深印在她的心坎上的话，就油然生起一股依恋之情。

en.t: When Shimamura thought of the words that had caused Komako to misunderstand, yet had sunk deep into her heart, he felt a sudden rush of lingering attachment.

units.source_text: 瞬时间，传来了火场那边杂沓的人声。

en.t: In an instant, a jumble of voices came from the direction of the fire.

units.source_text: 新的火舌又喷出了火星。

en.t: A fresh tongue of flame spat out sparks again.
